title: Ghar laut aao Asgar
body:
HAAYE ASGHAR HAAYE ASGHAR...(2)
Bano bula rahi hai...Ghar laut aao asghar..(2)
Jhule ka paas baithi aansoo baha rahi hai
Ghar laut aao asghar
Bano bula rahi hai...Ghar laut aao asghar..(2)
1)Lasho k darmiyaa'n tum aye laal dar na jaana.......(2)
Aa jaao jald beta ab raat aa rahi hai...
Ghar laut aao asghar
Bano bula rahi hai...Ghar laut aao asghar..(2)
2)Dekha hai jabse beta maqtal me jalta jhula....(2)
Lagta hai jaise meri beenaai jaa rahi hai
Ghar laut aao asghar
Bano bula rahi hai...Ghar laut aao asghar..(2)
3)Malum hai ye mujhko darte the raat me tum..(2)
Is yaad me hi madar shamme jala rahi hai
Ghar laut aao asghar
Bano bula rahi hai...Ghar laut aao asghar..(2)
4)Yaado'n me teri asghar jhule ki lakdiyo'n ko..(2)
Goudi me leke bano jhula jhula rahi hai
Ghar laut aao asghar
Bano bula rahi hai...Ghar laut aao asghar..(2)
5)Jabse gaye ho beta madar ka haal ye hai..(2)
Lori kise sunaye nauha suna rahi hai
Ghar laut aao asghar
Bano bula rahi hai...Ghar laut aao asghar..(2)
6)Tumse bichadke madar hai zindaa lash jaisi..(2)
Wo jee nahi sakegi halat bata rahi hai
Ghar laut aao asghar
Bano bula rahi hai...Ghar laut aao asghar..(2)
7)Aye chae(6)mahine wale goudi me teri madar.(2)
Tujhko uthaa na paai sadme utha rahi hai
Ghar laut aao asghar
Bano bula rahi hai...Ghar laut aao asghar..(2)
8)Jo "ARSALAN" rokar umme rabab ne di..(2)
"IMRAN" wo sada har maa ko rula rahi hai
Ghar laut aao asghar
Bano bula rahi hai...Ghar laut aao asghar..(2)
